shared_elements: low-relief carving on an upright stone slab/pillar
registers or rows of motifs stacked vertically
repeated animal heads in a row along the top
rounded, bulging schematic forms with outlined contours
stylised animal/creature heads shown in profile
quadruped or animal figures with visible eyes and snouts
justification: Both are relief-carved upright slabs organised into stacked horizontal registers, and both include rows of repeated rounded animal-like heads in profile with prominent eyes and snouts along the top. But A depicts a pictorial scene of discrete large animals (a quadruped, a bird, a scorpion-like creature, a small human-like figure) in open space, while B is a dense, uniform grid of self-contained cartouche-like sign blocks that fills the entire field, an organisational logic with no counterpart in A.
